title: Opening Ceremony: Career Counseling Sessions for Fall Semester 2026
text:
ABDUL WALI KHAN UNIVERSITY MARDAN

Official University News

AWKUM Opens Career Counseling Sessions for Fall Semester 2026

Career Counseling and Placement Center (CCPC)

The
Career Counseling and Placement Center (CCPC)

of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan organized an opening ceremony
for career counseling sessions for Fall Semester 2026. The ceremony
introduced newly admitted undergraduate students to the purpose,
scope, and working mechanism of the career counseling sessions,
highlighting their importance in guiding students towards informed
academic and professional choices.

The Worthy Vice Chancellor,
Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad
,
graced the occasion as the Chief Guest and shared his views on the
importance of career counseling for newly admitted students. He
emphasized that career counseling should begin from the very first
day of university life, enabling students to identify their
interests, develop relevant skills, and prepare for future career
opportunities.

The Vice Chancellor particularly highlighted the importance of

LinkedIn profile optimization
as an essential
component of career development. He advised students to showcase
their abilities and acquire skills relevant to current market
requirements rather than spending excessive time on other social
media platforms. He also emphasized effective time management
during campus life and urged students to maintain respect for
their teachers and university staff.

Career Development Message:

Students were encouraged to begin building their professional
profiles, develop market-relevant skills, and make effective use
of their university years.

In his welcome address,
Dr. Muhammad Bilal, Director,
Career Counseling and Placement Center (CCPC)
, briefed
the students about the Center's overall mandate, objectives, and
various career-related activities. He highlighted the role of the
Center in supporting students' professional development and
connecting their academic learning with future career opportunities.

On the occasion, Dr. Muhammad Bilal also announced the forthcoming

2+2 academic programme between Abdul Wali Khan University
Mardan and Trent University, Canada
, for BS students.
Under this programme, undergraduate students from

Environmental Science, Computer Science, and the Institute
of Business and Leadership
will have the opportunity to
complete their final four semesters at Trent University, Canada,
and receive their degrees from Trent University. He further shared
that the programme would be extended to other departments of AWKUM.

The ceremony was also attended by
Dr. Muhammad Azam
,
Dean, Faculty of Business and Economics;
Dr. Amir
,
Director, Admissions;
Mr. Fazal Sattar Durrani
,
Principal, PCA;
Dr. Niamatullah
and

Dr. Hazrat Ali
from the College of Animal Husbandry
and Veterinary Sciences;
Dr. Raza Shah Gillani
;

Dr. Omer Shehzad
, Chairperson, Pharmacy; and

Dr. Sajjad
, Chairperson, International Relations,
along with other university representatives.

The initiative reflects AWKUM's continued commitment to student
development, professional guidance, and career readiness. Through
the Career Counseling and Placement Center, the University aims
to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and professional
direction necessary to navigate an increasingly competitive
job market.
